decisions.reason: Its contract-relevant flame-retardant performance and dedicated visibility still justify keeping this option open because it fits core capabilities and broader market growth.
After two years with only modest visibility, its niche wool-blend profile and weaker fit with portfolio simplification make the option value too low versus reallocating resources.
As a newly launched fabric with its own page and broad use across upholstery and curtains, it remains too early and too strategically close to the core offer to abandon.
